# GNN round results (2026-10-31; generated by scripts/gnn_report.py)

Plan: [`GNN_MODELS_PLAN.md`](GNN_MODELS_PLAN.md); pre-registration: RESEARCH_PLAN §11, fifth amendment. Every feature (as published work). Pilot df-analyze budget (LightGBM, logistic regression, CatBoost; 10 trials); GNN rungs: 8-setting grid on training CV, 5 seeds, cross-fit on the saved folds. Test PR-AUC of each setup's Model A (or GNN rung). Verdict rule of 2026-10-19: supported if Δ > 0 on every split, mean Δ > SD and the Nadeau–Bengio corrected p over the training CV folds < 0.05. Holm p: within the pre-registered primary family, a sensitivity check beside the verdict. Headroom: Δ / (1 − PR-AUC of A).
